Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
For 50 years Dungeons & Dragons has taught generations of adventurers the same lesson—after the beast is slain, grab whatever glints in the torchlight and RUN. Returning to town with this bundle of every single shiny foil will make you the talk of the tavern.
Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Dungeons & Dragons®: An Exhibition of Adventure Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Dungeons & Dragons®: Death Is in the Eyes of the Beholder I Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Dungeons & Dragons®: Death Is in the Eyes of the Beholder II Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Dungeons & Dragons®: Astarion’s Thirst Rainbow Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Dungeons & Dragons®: Karlach’s Rage Rainbow Foil Edition
